evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-734 ENV-DIFFICULTY COMPETENCE-RECOVERY SWEEP (Track-1a; experiment_purpose=diagnostic, claim_ids=[], non_contributory -- EXCLUDED from governance scoring; PROMOTES / DEMOTES NOTHING). Holds the 724-A0 all-ON recipe FIXED and sweeps ENV DIFFICULTY DOWN a monotone staircase (D0=724 config -> D3 hazard-free) to answer the pivotal fork: is the foraging deficit an ENV-DIFFICULTY ceiling (curriculum-buildable) or a substrate/learner ceiling? 724 varied training duration/encoder-thaw/mechanism-count and found competence_deficit_diffuse; 728 landed the trained all-ON point (survives, does not forage: 0.167 res/ep below the 0.267 random floor -- a forage-vs-survive inversion). Four arms per rung on the capability_eval yardstick: random_walk floor / ree_trained_allon (724-A0 all-ON, trained+evaluated MATCHED per rung) / vanilla_ppo (matched raw-obs PPO learner-adequacy control, folds in 732a -- SAME observation interface, NOT the privileged oracle) / greedy_oracle ceiling+readiness. Load-bearing DV: foraging_competence (mean resources/ep). Readiness per rung: oracle clears the 1.0 floor (all_rungs_oracle_clear=True, D0=True, D3_hazard_free=True); D0 reproduces incompetence=True. Self-route (HYPOTHESIS, not a verdict): readiness_met=True -> if ree recovers at some de-risked rung => env_difficulty_recoverable (route curriculum, hardest rung=None); elif ppo recovers where ree does not => ree_substrate_ceiling; elif neither recovers even hazard-free => learner_or_observability_ceiling (route observation-encoding); else substrate_not_ready_requeue. label=ree_substrate_ceiling (ree_recovery_rungs=[], ppo_recovery_rungs=['D2_proximity_layout_derisked']). BRAKE-EXEMPT (competence/env diagnostic, not a conversion/de-commit falsifier; tags no claim). Maps to node conversion_ceiling_campaign:CAMPAIGN. Route to /failure-autopsy for adjudication before any governance action.

interpretation_grid.env_difficulty_recoverable: readiness holds AND ree_trained_allon clears the floor on a strict majority of seeds at some de-risked (oracle-achievable) rung. The deficit is an env-difficulty ceiling. HYPOTHESIS (not a verdict): route to /implement-substrate on a CURRICULUM (report hardest_ree_recovery_rung).
interpretation_grid.ree_substrate_ceiling: readiness holds, ree_trained_allon never clears the floor, but the matched vanilla PPO does at some de-risked rung. A standard learner forages the de-risked env on the SAME observation interface but the REE stack cannot -> a REE-specific substrate/representation ceiling, NOT env-buildable for REE.
interpretation_grid.learner_or_observability_ceiling: readiness holds (incl. the hazard-free D3 oracle clearing the floor) and NEITHER ree_trained_allon NOR the matched vanilla PPO clears the floor even in the maximally de-risked D3 env. No powered learner forages even a hazard-free env on this observation interface -> a deeper learner / observation-encoding problem (echoes 732a). Route to /implement-substrate on the observation encoding.
interpretation_grid.substrate_not_ready_requeue: D0 oracle cannot clear the floor, OR the all-ON stack already forages >= floor at D0 (724/728 premise not reproduced), OR a cell logged fewer than MIN_EVAL_EPISODES eval episodes, OR neither learner recovered but the hazard-free rung was not oracle-achievable. NOT a verdict -- re-examine env/floor/budget and re-queue. Draw NO conclusion about the competence root.
